_comment:
=== SCENARIO DEFINITIONS & TEMPLATE FOR ROW BOAT PUZZLES ===
To add a new scenario, create an entry with a unique key. Each scenario requires:
- title (string): Displayed in the tab.
- capacity (number): Maximum seats on the row boat or bridge.
- vehicleName (optional string): 'Row Boat', 'Rope Bridge', etc. Defaults to 'Row Boat'.
- actionVerb (optional string): 'Row Across', 'Cross Bridge', etc. Defaults to 'Row Across'.
- requireTorch (optional boolean): If true, Torch item must be with travelers crossing.
- trackTime (optional boolean): If true, calculates cumulative minutes based on slower traveler's time.
- timeLimit (optional number): Maximum allowable minutes before timeout.
- characters (array): Items or people crossing the river. Each has:
    id: unique identifier (string)
    name: full display name (string)
    abbr: short 1-3 letter badge (e.g. 'F', 'W', 'M1')
    type: 'human' | 'animal' | 'object' | 'monster'
    emoji: icon character
    canRow: boolean (true if can steer or cross independently)
    role: (optional) 'missionary' | 'cannibal' | 'husband' | 'wife' | 'monk' | 'chief' | 'torch'
    pairId: (optional) spouse / owner id
    minutes: (optional number) crossing speed in minutes
- rulesText (array of strings): Displayed in the Rules panel.
- conflicts (array of conflict objects evaluated on unattended banks):
    ruleType: 'predator_prey' | 'owner_absent' | 'majority' | 'jealous_couples' | 'chief_required'

_template_example.title: Example Scenario
rulesText: Monster (M) crushes Treasure (T) if left without Rower (R).
Boat holds up to 2 items.
Rower (R) must steer the boat.

mwgc.title: 1. Wolf, Goat & Cabbage
rulesText: Wolf (W) eats Goat (G) if left together without Farmer (F).
Goat (G) eats Cabbage (C) if left together without Farmer (F).
Boat holds up to 2 items.
Farmer (F) must be in the boat to row it.

3m3d.title: 2. 3 Men & 3 Dogs
rulesText: Dogs (D1, D2, D3) bite other men if their owner is absent.
Dogs are completely friendly with each other.
Boat has 3 seats and requires at least one Man to maneuver.

conflicts.message: A dog bit someone because their owner wasn't there!

missionaries.title: 3. 3 Men & 3 Monsters
rulesText: If Monsters (C) ever outnumber Scholars (M) on either riverbank, the Scholars are eaten!
Monsters only attack if at least one Scholar is present on that bank.
The boat holds at most 2 people.
Both Scholars and Monsters know how to row.

conflicts.message: Monsters outnumbered and devoured the Scholars on the bank!

couples.title: 4. Jealous Couples
rulesText: No woman can be in the presence of another man unless her own husband is also present.
Boat holds 2 people. Any adult can row.
Watch both banks as the boat travels!

conflicts.message: A wife was left with another man without her husband present!

monks.title: 5. Monks & Chief
rulesText: Novices (N1, N2) cannot be left on a bank with Monks without the Chief Abbot (CH) present.
Boat holds at most 2 people.
Novices cannot row alone; a Monk or Chief must steer.

conflicts.message: Novices cannot be disciplined by Monks without the Chief Abbot present!

bridge.title: 6. Torch & Bridge (Night)
rulesText: Four people must cross the rickety rope bridge at night.
Bridge holds at most 2 people (plus the Torch).
The Torch (🔥) MUST accompany every crossing!
When two cross, they move at the speed of the slower person.
Target: Get everyone across in 17 minutes or less!

custom.title: 7. Custom Setup
rulesText: Cat (C) eats Fish (F) without Alice (A).
Boat holds up to 2 items.
Alice must row the boat.

conflicts.message: Cat (C) harmed Fish (F) because Alice (A) was missing!
